attackers_goals: Perform lateral movement to new hosts to expand the foothold within a network.
description: A remotely triggered service initiated a command execution in a PsExec-like manner by a host that rarely triggers services to other remote hosts.
investigative_actions: Investigate the processes being spawned on the host for malicious activities. Correlate the RPC call from the source host and understand which software initiated it.
